_howto: Guided setup for Employee Costs (Demo / Setup mode).
title: Set up Employee Costs
intro: Work through these in order. You're in demo, so nothing affects your live system until you push it.

steps.title: Settings
steps.why: Weekly overtime, what's shown, and your wage advice template.

steps.title: Cost components
steps.why: The earnings, deductions and company contributions you use.

steps.title: Give people their components
steps.why: Which components each person gets, and how much.

steps.title: Payroll file layout
steps.why: A profile with the columns your payroll system expects.

steps.title: Test run
steps.why:
Prove it works, all in demo:
  1. Monthly Wage Calc: calculate last month for a few people.
  2. Payfiles: generate a preview and export it.
  3. Wage Advice and Bank Files: generate previews.
Calculations, exports and slips saved to ESS are never pushed to live.
